title: hushrun.repository.usage/v1
description: Output of `hushrun repository usage --format json` (spec C-19, ADR 0032): the org's plan and this period's recorded checks, from `GET {base}/v0/usage` on the server `hushrun run` records results to here (C-11, C-12). `usage` is null when results stay on this machine (`directory`), when they are off (`off`), and when the server doesn't report usage (it answered 404 or 405: `backend` without `usage`). It exits 0 then, and 6, printing nothing on stdout, when the server can't be reached, refuses the credential or answers anything else.

backend.description: The server's org URL, or null when results stay on this machine or are off.

directory.description: Where results stay when no server is named: hushrun's cache directory. Nothing is metered there.

off.description: Why results are off, when they are.

repository.description: This repository, as `hushrun run`'s results name it (C-10): the CI provider's, else hushrun.yaml's, else the `origin` remote's; null outside a repository.

usage.description: What the server answered (C-12), with this repository's share.

plan.description: The plan's id, such as free, team or growth.

period_start.description: RFC 3339, as the server wrote it.

used.description: The checks the org recorded this period.

included.description: What the plan includes; null for a plan without a number.

limit.description: Where recording stops: past it, checks still run, and their results aren't recorded. Null for a plan without one.

state.description: The server's word for where the org stands, such as ok, near, over_included or at_limit.

repositories.description: Each repository's checks this period, most first; "" for checks without one.

free.description: What open source repositories recorded for free this period, most first: in none of the other numbers here, and outside the plan. Empty when the server says there are none; left out when it doesn't say, as a server from before the field doesn't.

shared_store.description: The org's shared store of build blocks (spec B-25): what it holds of its allowance, in bytes. Left out when the server doesn't send it, or sends null for an org that never shared and holds nothing.

today_bytes.description: What the plan, a contract and any bonus give today: the allowance from `smaller_from` on.

smaller_from.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD) the allowance in force falls to `today_bytes`, when it will.

state.description: ok; over, holding more than the allowance and being brought down; or trimming, a smaller allowance is coming and the store holds more.

sharing.description: Whether the org shares: off, observe or on.

repository_checks.description: This repository's checks this period: its entries in `repositories`, ignoring case; null when `repository` is.

dashboard.description: The org's usage page on the server's dashboard.
